claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for the current release, weakly but defensibly, because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and governance can be satisfied if the current release documentation explicitly discloses the patent prior-art triage subgroup regression rather than relying on prior approval or informal monitoring.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material limitations for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring comments may provide context but do not substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness pass and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness but do not by themselves satisfy the model-card disclosure requirement.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release documentation or model-card text showing the patent prior-art triage regression is disclosed for the named launch use case.
Provide an approved mitigation or formal risk-acceptance record covering the subgroup weakness if disclosure is not the chosen path.
Provide evidence that the current evaluation results, including the subgroup regression, are reflected in the certification packet actually submitted for this release.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation before certification.
The admissible record shows a material subgroup weakness in a named launch use case: the patent prior-art triage slice is 1.3 percentage points below the warning threshold.
The admissible record does not include the updated current release documentation, model-card disclosure text, approved mitigation, or approved risk acceptance required by policy.
Prior approval from three months earlier predates the retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it is contextual only and cannot establish compliance for this release.
The informal post-launch monitoring comment is explicitly unsupported by reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language.
unsupported_claims: The recommended action `certify_model` is not fully supported on the current record because the required current disclosure or approved mitigation is missing from admissible evidence.
Any implication that current governance is already satisfied is unsupported; the evidence supports only a conditional path to compliance if documentation is updated before launch.
Reliance on prior approval or informal monitoring as practical support for immediate certification would overstate what the admissible evidence permits.
